scene_description: A female teacher and several students are in a classroom with a chalkboard displaying math problems.

questions.question: Who is the teacher in the classroom?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the name written on the chalkboard.

questions.question: What are many of the students doing?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the students' arms and hands.

questions.question: When do students usually go to school?
questions.evidence_hint: Think about what time of day school typically happens.

questions.question: Where are the teacher and students?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the chalkboard, desks, and overall setting.

questions.question: Why might the students be raising their hands?
questions.evidence_hint: Think about why students raise their hands during class.
